name: Kim Jong-un
role: Supreme leader of North Korea (2011–present); General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of State Affairs
summary: Kim Jong-un leads a one-party state that he describes as 'own-style socialism' built on self-reliance, state-planned economic management and a monolithic Party leadership. He has made nuclear weapons permanent policy, aligned with Russia and China, and in 2024 abandoned reunification, naming South Korea the principal enemy.

central-planning.rationale: The 2021 Party Congress report calls the national economy 'self-supporting and planned', calls for unified state management of products and for restoring the state's leading role and control in commerce.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Most recent clear line (2021): restore the state's leading role in commerce and preserve its socialist nature; he did not endorse a market economy under Party leadership, though earlier management reforms are reported by secondary sources.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Insists on strengthening the state's unified guidance of the economy and state control of commerce rather than letting markets allocate resources.

public-ownership.rationale: Describes the socialist economy as the backbone of the self-supporting economy and sets state plans for railways, power, metallurgy and chemical industry.

state-directs-investment.rationale: 2019 address directs state investment to the electric-power industry; 2021 report sets state priorities for key industrial sectors (metallurgy, chemicals, power, coal).

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Repeatedly makes self-reliance the 'lifeline' of development and rejects waiting for sanctions relief or outside help; 2019 slogan: new road of socialist construction 'under the banner of self-reliance'.

universal-healthcare.rationale: 2019 address calls for all people to realize the advantages of the socialist public health system, with modernized state medical institutions; 2021 report lists public health as a state-run priority.

collective-farming.rationale: Upholds cooperative farms as the base of socialist rural construction (2022 plenary writes off cooperative farm arrears) while encouraging side-line livestock by individual farmers.

local-production.rationale: 2024 'regional development 20x10 policy': build local factories using locally available resources and raw materials so each province supplies its own consumer goods.

independent-unions.rationale: 2021 report assigns working people's organizations the task of arming members with the Party's ideology and builds the youth league as the Party's reserve; organizations are Party instruments, not independent.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: 2021 report calls to preserve the socialist nature of public catering and welfare services and to restore the state's leading role in commerce and services.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Plans state-run expansion of drinking water supply, sewage plants and state-run commerce and public health in the 2021 report.

rich-first.rationale: Says the Party aims to eliminate disparities between worker and peasant, industry and agriculture, city and countryside; 2024: no backward region, and no one prioritized or discriminated against in construction.

one-party-rule.rationale: Calls for the monolithic leadership system of the Party and says people's government organs must remain unconditionally faithful to the idea and leadership of the WPK.

party-commands-army.rationale: Describes the People's Army as 'the army of our Party', to be developed as 'a revolutionary army modelled on the WPK'; he is supreme commander as Party chairman.

party-controls-media.rationale: 2021 report sets mass media the task of instilling the Party's ideas and policies in all people, with unitary management of Party ideological work and correction of shortcomings in the Party information field.

public-service-media.rationale: Treats newspapers, TV, radio and publishing as vehicles of the Party's lines; no independent public media tolerated in his programme.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: 2024: Party decisions are the 'lifeline' to be carried out 'without an inch of deflection'; 2021 report stresses revolutionary discipline and uncompromising criticism within the Party.

vanguard-party.rationale: Says the Party is the 'General Staff of the revolution' that leads and mobilizes the masses; cell secretaries link it to the masses.

leader-cult.rationale: 2021 report calls to defend and glorify the leadership's feats, refurbish sites inspected by the late leaders and establish the monolithic leadership system; public veneration of the Kims continues under him.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Record: succeeded his father Kim Jong Il in 2011 and rules on that lineage; no separate statement of principle found.

strong-leader.rationale: Champions the monolithic, unified leadership of the Party and its supreme leader as the basis of decision-making and unity.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Record: supreme commander of the armed forces; the 2022 nuclear forces law he announced gives him sole authority over nuclear use.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Directs Party-wide and society-wide campaigns against 'anti-socialist and non-socialist practices' and tasks law-enforcement organs with ensuring order (2020 and 2022 plenums); no organized opposition is tolerated.

separated-powers.rationale: Insists state organs execute the Party's lines and that the Party exercises unified leadership over the state; no checks between independent bodies.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Treats the Party as the necessary link between leader and masses and demands that cadres stay close to it; the opposite of bypassing parties.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: 2021 report names abuse of power, bureaucracy, irregularities and corruption as what the Party must most guard against; 2024 faults officials for neglect of regional living standards.

party-own-road.rationale: Upholds the principle of independence and 'our own-style socialism'; the 2021 report treats Korean-style socialism as the Party's own path.

national-self-determination.rationale: Repeatedly asserts that the DPRK's sovereignty and right to independent development cannot be infringed.

non-intervention.rationale: Condemns outside interference in the DPRK as a violation of sovereignty, but also backs Russia's war in Ukraine and sent troops under the 2024 treaty; evidence points both ways.

military-superiority.rationale: 2021 report: making the state's superiority in military technology irreversible and building 'the strongest military muscle in the world'.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Declares nuclear force building complete and its improvement continuing; 2022 law and speech say nuclear status is irreversible.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Sept 2022: nuclear status 'has now become irreversible' and there will 'never be any declaration of giving up our nukes or denuclearization'.

expand-nuclear.rationale: 2019 address calls for creating capacity for generating tidal, wind and atomic power under a far-reaching plan.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Record: signed the June 2024 mutual-defence treaty with Russia, ordered troops to Kursk, and called the alliance with Russia an honour.

collective-defense.rationale: Record: signed the 2024 treaty with Russia containing a pledge of mutual defence if either country is attacked, and ordered the deployment under it.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Record: formal alliance with Russia, 2021 call for joint anti-imperialist action with socialist countries; he is aligned with one bloc.

dominated-front.rationale: Calls for unity and cooperation with revolutionary parties and countries aspiring after independence and for a joint struggle against imperialism worldwide.

defeat-communism.rationale: Leads a communist-led state and states the 'ideal of communism will surely come true'; calls for defeating imperialism instead.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Says the mission of the armed forces cannot change while imperialism remains, and calls for defending the socialist system and its planned economy.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Builds 'own-style' socialism in the DPRK alone by self-reliance and presents it as secure in itself, rather than dependent on revolution elsewhere.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: 2021: as long as imperialism and its threat of aggression remain, defence and the state's capabilities must be steadily bolstered and state guidance of the economy strengthened.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Most recent position (Jan 2024): reunification is no longer possible; the ROK is a foreign state, 'reunification' concepts and monuments to be removed.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Proposes writing into the constitution annexation of the ROK 'in case a war breaks out', yet says the force is not for preemptive 'reunification by force' and DPRK will not unilaterally start a war.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Says the DPRK will never unilaterally unleash a war, but the 2022 law allows nuclear preemptive and automatic strikes and he has sent troops abroad.

arms-reduction.rationale: 2021 report: 'there can never be satisfaction in strengthening the military strength'; calls for continuous buildup of defence capabilities.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Repeatedly calls for continuously strengthening the People's Army and defence industry; rejects disarmament.

close-ties-china.rationale: 2021 report: prioritized DPRK-China relations, five summits with Xi and 'friendship with socialism as its core'.

nation-first.rationale: Promotes the 'our state first' principle that every Party member should hold as an element of faith.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Says US and ROK dream of the DPRK's 'collapse' and 'unification by absorption', and that the US keeps sanctions to gradually reduce the country's strength.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Record: DPRK under his leadership recognized Russia's 2022 annexations of Ukrainian oblasts.

empower-police-military.rationale: Makes defence buildup a top state priority and calls for raising the role of law-enforcement organs to ensure social order.

state-harmful.rationale: Calls for a stronger state and a socialist rule-of-law state that is 'unified, scientific and strategically controlled'.

decide-locally.rationale: Encourages regions to develop but through a centrally designed policy with compulsory state funds; stresses the state's unified guidance of economic work.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: 2019 address: ensure no immoral or uncultured practices run counter to the people's emotions; 2021: eradicate anti-socialist, non-socialist practices and set art tasks of Juche character.

person-over-state.rationale: Says the state exists to serve the people and puts 'people first', but also puts national duty before personal interest; mixed.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Praises people who 'place national affairs before their family ones' and promotes single-minded unity of Party and people.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Praises patriots who put the state before their families and demands selfless devotion by officials.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: 2021: art should embody Juche character, national identity and modernity.

patriotic-education.rationale: Calls for education in revolutionary traditions, teaching pupils to be revolutionary talents and 'reserves of socialism'.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Builds the youth league as the Party's reserve; at the 2020 parade he reviewed Young Red Guards and Worker-Peasant Red Guards.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: April 2025: called soldiers who died in Kursk 'heroes and representatives of the honour of the motherland'.

total-state.rationale: Report sets Party and state direction over culture, education, mass media, science and the economy under 'unified, scientific and strategic control'.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Links patriotism and devotion to the people: 'everything for the people', politics of the people-first principle.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Leads a communist party and rejects a 'third way'; commits to socialism and communism as the goal.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: 2019: coal mining is a 'primary front' of the self-supporting economy and coal output must be raised; he also pushes hydro, tidal, wind and atomic power.

limit-growth.rationale: Sets maximum economic growth targets in five-year plans; protects environment alongside, not instead of, growth.

revolution-justified.rationale: Calls the 'victory of the revolution inevitable' and frames the Party as the leader of the Korean revolution.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Calls for tangible results for the people and conformity with practical conditions in economic work, yet insists revolutionary ideology lead.

people-in-arms.rationale: Builds a professional high-tech army while also organizing Worker-Peasant Red Guards and 'all-people' defence.

notes: Most KCNA texts are official summaries, not verbatim speeches; the full 8th Congress report was never published. Reunification: positive in 2018-2019 (inter-Korean declarations), reversed in Dec 2023 / Jan 2024; the latest position is used. Party and state positions are attributed to him only where his own reports or orders state them. The 2020 anti-reactionary thought law and the Singapore/Hanoi texts were not opened and are not used.
